_notes: Placeholders in {braces} are filled by code. Reaction 'held' is Bulwark only. Barks: pick one at random per event; 'shaken' plays once when squad morale enters Shaken.

abilities.<id>.range: abilities.<id>.range as 'min-max', or one number if equal
abilities.<id>.def/res/move/jump/hitBonus/push/blockedB: the same-named field on the ability, its buff or its debuff (move as a signed number in thornsnare, unsigned in pinningArrow)

millFord.pre.speaker: narrator
millFord.pre.text: Mill Ford, at dawn. Two flour carts from Ashford wait at the water's edge.

millFord.pre.speaker: tobin
millFord.pre.text: That's a lot of grey cloaks for two carts of flour.

millFord.pre.speaker: maren
millFord.pre.text: Six. Spears, a bow, a mage, and someone who likes giving orders.

millFord.pre.speaker: captain
millFord.pre.text: Carters of Ashford! By your debt oath, turn those carts around.

millFord.pre.speaker: narrator
millFord.pre.text: Gold light rings the carters' wrists. Slowly, stiffly, they begin to turn.

millFord.pre.speaker: calla
millFord.pre.text: They're compelling them. They didn't even ask.

millFord.pre.speaker: binder
millFord.pre.text: Captain. Three of them aren't in the Ledger. Nothing to hold. The healer is a sworn Sister.

millFord.pre.speaker: captain
millFord.pre.text: Unsworn, then. No one will miss them. Take the carts.

millFord.pre.speaker: calla
millFord.pre.text: I'd miss them. Just so you know.

millFord.pre.speaker: maren
millFord.pre.text: We were paid to get those carts to market. That's the one thing I'm sure of today.

millFord.pre.speaker: wren
millFord.pre.text: Cliff on the right. Their archer goes up there.

millFord.pre.speaker: tobin
millFord.pre.text: So we just fight the Oathcourt? The actual Oathcourt?

millFord.pre.speaker: maren
millFord.pre.text: Swear a vow if you want one. On the field it isn't a promise. It's a plan with teeth.

millFord.post.win.speaker: narrator
millFord.post.win.text: The last grey cloak goes down in the shallows. The gold light fades from the carters' wrists.

millFord.post.win.speaker: calla
millFord.post.win.text: Breathe. It's gone for now. You're all right.

millFord.post.win.speaker: tobin
millFord.post.win.text: We beat them. Maren, we actually beat the Oathcourt.

millFord.post.win.speaker: maren
millFord.post.win.text: We beat six of them. There are a lot more than six.

millFord.post.win.speaker: wren
millFord.post.win.text: Their binder wrote something down. Before.

millFord.post.win.speaker: maren
millFord.post.win.text: Then get the carts moving. We're over the ford before anyone reads it.

millFord.post.win.speaker: narrator
millFord.post.win.text: Far to the north, in Highmere, a man in an iron mask is handed a report. He reads it twice.

millFord.post.loss.speaker: maren
millFord.post.loss.text: Fall back! Over the hill, now!

millFord.post.loss.speaker: captain
millFord.post.loss.text: Run, then. You can't break an oath you never made. You can still bleed.

millFord.post.loss.speaker: narrator
millFord.post.loss.text: The carts roll back toward Ashford, the carters walking beside them like sleepers.

millFord.post.loss.speaker: tobin
millFord.post.loss.text: We left them. We just left them there.

millFord.post.loss.speaker: maren
millFord.post.loss.text: We're alive to try again. That's all today gets.

millFord.post.loss.speaker: calla
millFord.post.loss.text: Then let's try again before they reach the mill.

oath.maren: No blade passes me to them.
oath.tobin: Nobody gets past me. Nobody. I mean it.
oath.wren: Stay behind me. Nothing reaches you.
oath.calla: No blade passes me to them. Not today.

maren.kept: Everyone stood up at the end. Good.
maren.lapsed: Nobody came at me. I'll take it.

tobin.held: I blocked it! Did everyone see that?
tobin.kept: Everyone's still standing. Reckon that's partly me.
tobin.broken: I was right there. I was right there.
tobin.lapsed: Nobody even swung at me. Is that good?

calla.held: That one was meant for you. You're welcome.
calla.kept: Everyone's whole. That's enough for me.
calla.broken: I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. Get up.
calla.lapsed: No one needed shielding. I'll count that a mercy.

oath.maren: I go in alone, and I come out.
oath.tobin: I go in alone, and I come out. Both parts, please.
oath.calla: I'll go in alone. Don't follow me.

maren.broken: Should've cleared them off first. Noted.

tobin.kept: I went in alone and I came out. It held me up.
tobin.broken: It cracked. Like ice. I felt it go.
tobin.lapsed: Never got one on my own. Next time.

calla.kept: I went alone and came back. Don't make a habit of letting me.
calla.broken: That wasn't mine to take. Not like that.
calla.lapsed: I couldn't find the space. Just as well.

downed: Is this bad? This is bad.

deploy.title: Deploy and swear
deploy.subtitle: Place your units, then choose a vow for each. Vows are optional.
deploy.noVowNote: Fights unsworn: no Resolve, no Shadow.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.summary: Guard an ally from {goal} attack, and let no ally within {breakRadius} tiles fall.
bulwark.whileSworn: Guard: you take single-target attacks aimed at allies within {guardRadius} tiles.
bulwark.kept: At battle end: +{resolve} Resolve toward {oathClass}, +{morale} morale.
bulwark.breaks: Breaks if an ally within {breakRadius} tiles falls, even after the guard.
bulwark.broken: Surge: +{surgeAtk} Atk, +{surgeMove} Move, Guard ends. +{shadow} Shadow toward {shadowClass}, {moraleBroken} morale.

loneBlade.name: Lone Blade
loneBlade.summary: Defeat {goal} foe with no ally beside you.
loneBlade.whileSworn: +{atkWhenAlone} Atk while no ally is beside you. Downed allies don't count.
loneBlade.kept: As soon as it's done: +{resolve} Resolve toward {oathClass}, +{morale} morale.
loneBlade.breaks: Breaks if you defeat a foe while a standing ally is beside you.
loneBlade.broken: Surge: +{surgeAtk} Atk, +{surgeHit} hit. +{shadow} Shadow toward {shadowClass}, {moraleBroken} morale.

broken.label: Broken
broken.tooltip: Vow broken. The surge is yours for the rest of the battle.

frozen.label: Frozen
frozen.tooltip: Downed. The vow can't break while frozen and resolves at battle end.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.tooltip: Hits the target and the tiles on either side of it. Enemies only. Cooldown {cd}.

shove.name: Shove
shove.tooltip: Pushes the target back {push} tile. +{blockedBonus} damage if blocked or it falls {fallMinDrop}+ levels. Cooldown {cd}.

brace.name: Brace
brace.tooltip: +{def} Def until your next turn, and every attack on you counts as from the front. Cooldown {cd}.

aimedShot.name: Aimed Shot
aimedShot.tooltip: A slow, careful shot with +{hitBonus} hit. Range {range}. Cooldown {cd}.

pinningArrow.name: Pinning Arrow
pinningArrow.tooltip: Light damage. The target loses {move} Move until the end of its next turn. Cooldown {cd}.

volley.name: Volley
volley.tooltip: Arrows on a plus-shaped area. Hits allies too. Range {range}. Cooldown {cd}.

sureFooting.name: Sure Footing
sureFooting.tooltip: Passive. +{jump} Jump, and climbing costs no extra Move.

spark.name: Spark
spark.tooltip: A small bolt of magic. Always hits. Range {range}.

mend.name: Mend
mend.tooltip: Heals an ally for {heal} HP, or revives a downed ally. Range {range}. Cooldown {cd}.

ward.name: Ward
ward.tooltip: An ally gains +{def} Def and +{res} Res until your next turn starts. Range {range}. Cooldown {cd}.

thornsnare.name: Thornsnare
thornsnare.tooltip: Thorns on a plus-shaped area. Enemies only, {move} Move until their next turn ends. Cooldown {cd}.

kindle.name: Kindle
kindle.tooltip: A heavy spell on one target. Range {range}. Cooldown {cd}.

thrust.name: Spear Thrust
thrust.tooltip: Strikes up to {rangeMax} tiles away in a straight line.

binderSpark.name: Seal Spark
binderSpark.tooltip: A bolt of oath magic. Always hits. Range {range}.

fromTile.cooling: {ability} is cooling down (ready in {n}), so it's left out.
fromTile.breaksLoneBlade: Downing a foe here breaks Lone Blade (ally beside you)

preview.breaksVowDetail: {vow}: {ally} is beside you if this defeats the target.

shaken.name: Shaken
shaken.tooltip: {hit} hit now, {move} Move from each unit's next turn.

reckoning.title: Reckoning
reckoning.subtitle: What was sworn, and what came of it.

bulwark.kept: Guarded {n} attack · no ally within {breakRadius} tiles fell
bulwark.lapsed: Battle ended at 0 / {goal} · no attack guarded

loneBlade.broken: Defeated a foe with an ally beside
loneBlade.lapsed: Battle ended at 0 / {goal} · no solo defeat
